Each post is its own folder, so images and data can sit next to the `.qmd`
that uses them. Copy `blog/posts/2026-07-10-first-post/` and edit.

Math renders without doing anything: $\nabla \cdot \mathbf{E} = \rho / \varepsilon_0$.

Code cells execute at render time and the results get cached in `_freeze/`,
so CI never needs your environment:

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
import numpy as np
np.linspace(0, 1, 5)
```

Delete the `eval: false` once you've committed `_freeze/`.
